title: NLO – DMS Feeder Interlock Classifier Status

fields.latestPosition: Draft form created in the In Development folder on 18/09.
fields.nextAction: Add to register, assign priority and approver.
fields.why: DMS feeders can be started with the classifier dart plugs in manual at 0%. This has led to classifier overfilling events and could bog the classifiers.
fields.design:
- Add a process interlock preventing feed to the DMS classifiers while the dart plug is closed
- 160-FE-0481: 160-LIC-0470 Classifier Controller in Auto or Manual > 5%
- 160-FE-0497: 160-LIC-0472 Classifier Controller in Auto or Manual > 5%
fields.impact: DMS feeders will not start unless the classifier level controller is in Auto or Manual above 5%.
